description: GPT-4o ("o" for omni) is OpenAI's flagship multimodal model that can reason across audio, vision, and text in real time. It matches GPT-4 Turbo performance on text and code while being significantly faster and 50% cheaper.

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse mixture of licensed data, data created by human trainers, and publicly available data. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Trained using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) with a combination of supervised fine-tuning and reward modeling. Specific training methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Matches GPT-4 Turbo on text in English and code, with significant improvements in non-English languages. Faster and more cost-efficient than GPT-4 Turbo.

knownLimitations: May generate incorrect or misleading information
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff date
Can exhibit biases present in training data
May not always follow complex multi-step instructions perfectly
Audio output capabilities may have pronunciation limitations for some languages

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: OpenAI has implemented safety mitigations but the model may still exhibit biases from training data. Regular red-teaming and safety evaluations are conducted.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in content filtering, usage policies enforcement, and rate limiting. Model refuses harmful requests through RLHF training.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Data sent to the API may be used to improve the model unless opted out. Enterprise and API users can opt out of data training.
